title: melicope villosa
intro: Melicope villosa, commonly known as rough-hair melicope or rough melicope, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Polynesian medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Melicope villosa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are believed to help soothe digestive issues and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Melicope villosa include coumarins, limonoids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
